triggers.detailsText: We are pleased to report another strong quarter with revenue growth 30% year-on-year to INR496.3 crore, EBITDA increasing 29% to INR72.4 crore, and PAT growing at 43% to INR42.4 crore. Coming to business area, our CDMO business continue to be a key growth driver for the company by contributing nearly 70% to the total revenue in both Q2 and H1 FY27, supported by continued client traction, healthy business momentum across our customer base, and an expanding product portfolio. My question is, if Jammu ramps up to its full capacity utilization of about 90 odd percent, even at 100 odd percent, the revenue realization from Jammu facility would be about INR1,900 odd crore.
filingKeyFacts: We are pleased to report another strong quarter with revenue growth 30% year-on-year to INR496.3 crore, EBITDA increasing 29% to INR72.4 crore, and PAT growing at 43% to INR42.4 crore.
